basis: NSS Cognition Architecture Low-Bit handoff pages5-9,20-21; G03/G05 and NBR-01. Brain-inspired functional hypotheses; no fly simulation or physiological data fitting.

criteria.added_value: Show separate comparisons with same-size one-step readout repair, same-representation nearest decoder, and equal-byte two-copy mean. Any extra complexity needs a distinct advantage, not just a win over hold.
criteria.competence: For each pair: clean known/UNKNOWN >=95% at4 rounds, overwrite changed-key>=95% at4, resetUNKNOWN>=95% at4096. No seed excluded.
criteria.decision: Keep scoped mechanism / revise named defect / reject scoped candidate / gather specific missing evidence. No production qualification.
criteria.long_stability: Clean known/UNKNOWN>=95% at4096 and <=1pp drop from16.
criteria.mechanism_recovery: AtGaussian std1.0 and4 rounds, mean paired known-accuracy gain>=5pp over same candidate maintenance-off, with no >2pp loss on clean known, cleanUNKNOWN or qualifiedoverwrite. This is diagnostic only, not acceptance over stronger controls.

development: 3x600-step devfits, seed141rep441learning; zero-reset guard fixed after dev-only numerical failure. All dev failures retained; no main-seed tuning.

evaluation.damage: Gaussian independent and common-mode, first lane only, coordinate erasure, directed mixing toward wrong prototype, erasefast/eraseall
evaluation.endpoint_control: Same recurrent checkpoint; perform equal logical number of repairs all at end versus one per event. Exact fixed-point skip counted separately from nominal budget.
evaluation.overwrite: A new qualified value ataddress0 after32 rounds; measure changed-key accuracy and stale answers at0/1/4/32/128
evaluation.unknown: Report known and UNKNOWN separately, including corrupted empty states. Never pool these into recall only.

interventions: Disable recurrent maintenance; equalize fast/slow rates; independent vs common-mode damage; oldvalue+valid replacement; wholly erase all unprotected state. Wrong stable outputs remain failures.
limitations: Source acquisition shared/reused; new maintenance training receives direct code targets
No Transformer architecture ranking; unassisted baseline remains unresolved
No delayed-credit, low-bit trace or recurrent reasoning study
pairing: rep301/seed501 etc; five previously trained representation seeds, five new paired training-data seeds. Do not report as five newly pretrained language models.
purpose: Controlled persistent-state maintenance, perturbation recovery, update agility and empty-state integrity. No topology replacement.
resource_budget: CPU one torch thread;15 main fits x1800steps. No downloads, external writes, network training, serving changes or user-private data. Energy/device benchmarkNOT_MEASURED.
reuse: Prior wide soft-state frozen value embeddings16D and readout; exact qualified admission replaces source learned gate ONLY to isolate maintenance. Old foundation and archives untouched.
scaffolding: Four supplied addresses, eight categorical values + UNKNOWN zero; observed score>=0.5 means write, lower means no-op. Exact clear. Codes and their readout already competent.

training.data: Identical first/second-lane noisy inputs, masks and labels across arms per seed. Gaussian std0/.1/.25/.5,20%coordinate erasure subset, qualified writes, exact resets. Code targets explicitly supervised.
training.fairness: Shared data and steps, NOT shared FLOPs. Fast/slow has two lanes/512 bytes, single256. Readout denoiser same2128-parameter map. Exact/nearest controls carry explicit structure; original preparation and code bank count.
training.loss: normalized code MSE +0.2 original-head CE, averaged over1/2/4 training rounds; readout arm one round
